features.name: DX Cluster
features.notes: Direct Telnet connection; no proxy required. Core spot display equivalent to original.

features.name: Moon Phase & Position
features.notes: Moon phase, rise/set, azimuth/elevation equivalent.

features.name: SDO Solar Images
features.notes: Direct SDO image fetch; selectable wavelengths.

features.name: Weather (DE/DX)
features.notes: Uses open-meteo.com directly.

features.name: Gimbal/Rotator Control
features.notes: Hamlib rotctld TCP protocol present. Auto-track satellite/DX implemented in RotatorService. Manual az/el commands present. MISSING: upover mode (el>90 to avoid az-wrap through north when tracking satellites near EOT). No set_rotator REST endpoint.

features.name: Satellite Tracker
features.notes: libpredict v2, TLE management, satellite track on map. Reviewed 2026-03-02: SatPanel and SatelliteManager implement equivalent functionality. No get_satellite.txt or set_satname REST endpoints.

features.name: ADIF Log Viewer
features.notes: List with band/mode filter; QSO pins on map. Reviewed 2026-03-02: functional equivalent.

features.name: Santa Tracker
features.notes: Seasonal Dec 24/25.

features.name: EME Planning Tool
features.notes: EMEToolPanel (91 lines) shows current DE/DX elevation + mutual window status. Original emetool.cpp: full 2-day moon elevation chart (48h), time axis, 'Next Up' table showing next simultaneous above-horizon window, 30s micro-stepping for precision rise/set. The 2-day chart, next-up table, and micro-stepping are NOT implemented in Next.
suggested_gaps: next-up table for DE+DX mutual window

features.name: Stopwatch / Count-up
features.notes: StopwatchPanel has start/stop/reset with elapsed time display. MISSING: count-up mode with lap recording (original had full lap table). Countdown pane is separate (CountdownPanel). No set_stopwatch REST endpoint.

features.name: Solar Flux / Kp / SSN History
features.notes: SFI, Kp, SSN plots via HistoryPanel.

features.name: Live Spots (PSK/WSPR/RBN)
features.notes: Source selector for PSK Reporter, WSPRnet, RBN.

features.name: Callsign Watchlist
features.notes: Reviewed 2026-03-02: WatchlistStore + WatchlistPanel + WebServer debug endpoint present. Alert-on-spot wired.

features.name: Band Conditions (DE-DX VOACAP)
features.notes: Per-band reliability bars.

features.name: ENV Temperature Pane (PLOT_CH_TEMPERATURE)
features.notes: Original dedicated pane showing BME280 temperature history graph. BME280Provider collects T/P/H data (backend present) but no WidgetType::ENV_TEMP or equivalent display pane exists in Next.

features.name: ENV Pressure Pane (PLOT_CH_PRESSURE)
features.notes: Same as env_temp: backend exists, no display widget.

features.name: ENV Humidity Pane (PLOT_CH_HUMIDITY)
features.notes: Same as env_temp: backend exists, no display widget.

features.name: ENV Dewpoint Pane (PLOT_CH_DEWPOINT)
features.notes: Same as env_temp: derived dewpoint, no display widget.

features.name: Photosensor Auto-Dim
features.notes: Original supported LTR329 I2C light sensor and RPi A0 ADC for automatic brightness. BrightnessManager has schedule-based dimming and sysfs backlight but no photosensor input.

features.name: WiFi Signal Meter
features.notes: Original used Arduino WiFi.RSSI() — ESP8266/ESP32 only. Not applicable to Linux desktop.

features.name: GPIO (MCP23X17) Control
features.notes: Original used MCP23X17 I2C GPIO expander on RPi for LED blink etc. Linux desktop has no equivalent hardware peripheral.

top_gaps: 4x ENV sensor widget panes (TEMP/PRESS/HUMID/DEWPT) — backend data collected but no display
EME Tool 2-day elevation chart and next-up table (current code is stub)
Gimbal upover mode for satellite tracking
~28 missing REST endpoints from original API surface (set_pane, set_alarm, set_stopwatch, get_satellite, etc.)
